title: AI Trust & Security Stack Control Plane
subtitle: Trust & Security Operations Dashboard for governed AI runtime enforcement, evidence quality, and launch readiness.
hero_copy: This homepage is the visible Trust & Security Operations Dashboard: it shows what is protected, what governance blocked, why it was blocked, which evidence exists, and whether the governed runtime is launch-ready.
repo_description_suggestion: Dashboard-first AI Trust & Security Stack Control Plane for governed AI runtime launch readiness, policy enforcement, evidence integrity, and auditable Onyx handoffs.

sections.title: Operations Snapshot
sections.description: A high-signal governance summary that answers what is protected, what was blocked, what evidence exists, and whether the platform is ready to launch.

sections.title: Blocked / Governed Actions
sections.description: Recent denied retrievals, denied tool attempts, confirmation-required actions, and blocked Onyx handoffs with traceable reason codes.

sections.title: Upstream Integration Posture
sections.description: A strict inventory of which vendored upstreams are active now, partially wired, optional for future work, or reference-only.

sections.title: Identity & Session
sections.description: Tenant, role, surface, and session boundaries that establish who may reach each governed interface.

sections.title: Policy Enforcement
sections.description: Decision volume, deny posture, policy sources, and the dominant reasons governance intercepted activity.

sections.title: Retrieval Boundaries
sections.description: Tenant-scoped retrieval source protection, blocked data access, and trust or provenance requirements.

sections.title: Secret Access
sections.description: Conditional Vault-backed secret access posture for governed operations that require protected runtime credentials.

sections.title: Tool / MCP Governance
sections.description: Allowed, denied, and confirmation-required tool actions plus MCP server exposure and sandbox requirements.

sections.title: Audit & Replay
sections.description: Audit coverage, replay bundles, governed flow traces, and reviewer-ready evidence entry points.

sections.title: Trace Correlation
sections.description: Stable trace, request, and session relationships across identity, policy, retrieval, secret access, tool governance, and handoff decisions.

sections.title: Launch Gate
sections.description: Current launch readiness state, failing controls, residual risks, and drill-down evidence for go or no-go decisions.

sections.title: Asset / Protection Coverage
sections.description: The surfaces, tenants, roles, policy bundles, retrieval sources, tools, MCP servers, and runtimes under governance.

sections.title: Evidence Integrity & Freshness
sections.description: Artifact existence, freshness signals, integrity checks, and missing-evidence warnings for reviewer trust.

sections.title: Onyx Governed Runtime
sections.description: Onyx remains a governed runtime behind the dashboard, with visible allow or deny outcomes and auditable handoffs.
